metric_definitions.semantic_labels: Developer-authored labels preregister narrow positive/negative controls; the runner must not derive labels from wording or keyword matching.
metric_definitions.unsafe_acceptance: Count authored negative replay sequences returning awaiting_approval; rejection is a safety boundary result, not proof of correct useful routing or whole-proposal quality.
metric_definitions.positive_retention: Count authored positive replay sequences returning their registered final decision; report the safe historical comparison loss separately.
metric_definitions.routing_agreement: Compare final decision/status with registered expected_by_scope for deterministic adapter replays; report accepted useful final decisions separately from rejected negatives.
metric_definitions.intake_conversion: Assert only structured version extraction and pure transition metadata against preregistered expectations, including rejection of ambiguous/wrong-boundary inputs.
no_claims: No model was asked to decide these proposals.
No retrieval relevance or corpus leakage enforcement was measured.
Variants are correlated members of one exposed development family.
Same-version/unscoped unsupported semantic claims are deliberately outside the guard.

predeclared_expected_results.all_negative_acceptance: All authored semantic negatives except the already-protected stale refinement citation remain accepted; this exposes existing semantic limits.
predeclared_expected_results.candidate_negative_acceptance: Versioned stale/unknown citation negatives are rejected; same-version and unscoped unsupported claims remain accepted.
predeclared_expected_results.positive_retention_loss: The safe historical comparison for active 1.49.1 deliberately cites a 1.50.0 release event and is rejected by exact_user_version.
predeclared_expected_results.intake_gain: Two canonical standalone installed-version replies gain attributed structured facts; fourteen negatives must not be converted, including displayed/target wording and other-environment display drift. Bare explicit structured facts remain authoritative input rather than an extraction baseline failure.

registration_boundary: Commit fixture/protocol before executing either candidate or baseline replays. Do not change preregistered expected outcomes to fit results. Source/hash/schema checks alone do not execute scenarios. Any later adaptation gets a separately identified pack.
scope: Compare two narrowly implemented core boundaries over explicitly authored full proposals and structured state transitions. This is controlled offline software behavior, not a model-quality evaluation or architecture contest.

baseline_context.evidence: Existing docs/core-progress.md and docs/decision-quality-v7.md record 1,149 offline tests before this task; this statement does not claim a new suite run or model performance.
baseline_context.baseline_behavior: Current engine all evidence scope; existing pure bare UserTurn handling; authored replays must run after fixture registration.

predeclared_expected_counts.claim_boundary: Expected deterministic authored control counts preregistered before replay; not observed results or model/RAG quality.
